messages.subject: guide_colourbar title.vjust not working
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to change the vertical position of the legend title with title.vjust but is not working.

I tried 3 different values but the title is at the same position for the 3 different values.

df <- reshape2::melt(outer(1:4, 1:4), varnames = c("X1", "X2"))

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(X1, X2)) + geom_tile(aes(fill = value))

p1 + scale_fill_continuous(guide = guide_colorbar(title.vjust = 0.1))

p1 + scale_fill_continuous(guide = guide_colorbar(title.vjust = 1))

p1 + scale_fill_continuous(guide = guide_colorbar(title.vjust = 5))

messages.author: e3f5ae2bbb1140ed
messages.subject: Re: guide_colourbar title.vjust not working
parts:
Hi Manuel
The legend's horizontal title position (left- and right-justified and centered) is controlled by the legend.title.align parameter within the theme() function and accepts values between 0 (left) and 1 (right) with 0.5 being centered. I am not aware of a way to adjust the vertical position of the legend title. Try the following to center the legend title horizontally:

p1 + scale_fill_continuous() + theme(legend.title.align=0.5)

See the following links for additional information:
scale_fill_continuous(): http://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/scale_gradient.html
theme(): http://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/theme.html

Emilio
